race.description: Wellington Soldiers Memorial Club Mdn Hcp
race.comment: SIMPLY SONNET (11) returned from a spell three-and-a-half weeks ago when she was ridden conservatively near the rear before finishing sixth over the 900m burner at Newcastle. Much better placed here and can improve sharply. BLIND SQUIRREL (1) hasn't raced for over a year but has trialled sharply leading into this and draws the A1. May need the run but deserves consideration, especially if there's market support. IT'S OUR TURN (6) produced a fair effort on debut last time at Narromine over 800m and should've come on from the experience. ANGELINA RUN (8) is a Harry Angel filly on debut for the Mirfin yard. Has been fitted with a Mudgee trial placing and is in the mix. Market support will add confidence.
